description: This file defines a generic serializer class 'ConcreteTypeSerializer' for reference types in Orleans serialization framework, handling serialization and deserialization logic with support for references and type expectations.

classes.name: ConcreteTypeSerializer
classes.description: A serializer class for reference types that manages serialization, deserialization, and reference handling within Orleans serialization framework.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a value of type TField, handling references and type checking.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads and deserializes a value of type TField from the reader, with support for reference types and type validation.

methods.name: ReadValueSealed
methods.description: Reads and deserializes a value of type TField without type checking, handling object references.
